evidence.text: So I think you’re super impressive. And I’ve been wrestling with this one. But I think ultimately for me it’s a pass. Mostly because I think the market is huge, but it’s really fragmented. And I keep coming back to myself and saying, gosh, like of the companies I’ve seen that are sort of of your ilk, what has it taken to get to a really large outcome. And it’s gigantic product catalogs.I think about Bonobos, Everlane, some of the companies I’ve seen that have achieved like pretty healthy run rates, different model, but it just feels to me like the number of shots that you’ll have to hit in a row to get to the size of company that makes sense for me, it’s, it’s a, it’s a difficult lift.
